subject: SIG + SOC2 evidence delivery plan for Helios SupplyChain RFP
messages:
From: Amir Qureshi <amir.qureshi@helios-supply.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helios-supply.com
Date: 2027-07-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial SIG/SOC2 asks + evidence deadline for RFP

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As part of our RFP intake we need a detailed control mapping and supporting evidence for SIG, SOC 2 (Type II), and ISO 27001 scopes that Redwood will include in our vendor pack. The buyer team is particularly focused on:

- Data residency and isolation (VPC/private deployment options)
- Key management (KMS/HSM proofs and rotation policy)
- Access control and privileged access logs (recent audit period)
- Change management and release rollouts (canary/A-B policies)

Can you confirm what artifacts you can produce by Friday 2027-07-30? Attached is our RFP controls worksheet (Helios_RFP_Controls_2027-07-26.pdf) — it has our mapping template and the sections we will include in the final evaluation. Also, procurement will need a simple mutual action plan (dates) and an NDA if there are restricted artifacts.

We prefer to receive evidence as: crosswalk (spreadsheet), PDF excerpts (SOC 2 summary), log extracts (CSV), and architectural diagrams. If any items require an on-site or private deployment snapshot, note that explicitly so we can schedule procurement approvals.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and the tentative delivery timeline.

Thanks,
Amir Qureshi
Head of Vendor Risk | Helios SupplyChain
amir.qureshi@helios-supply.com

[attachment: Helios_RFP_Controls_2027-07-26.pdf (pdf)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Qureshi <amir.qureshi@helios-supply.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai, procurement@helios-supply.com
Date: 2027-07-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/SOC2 asks + evidence deadline for RFP

Hi Amir —

Thanks for the clear list and the RFP worksheet. We can provide a structured evidence package that aligns to your template. High-level plan (can deliver initial package by EOD 2027-07-30):

1) Crosswalk: redwood-sig-ctrl-crosswalk-v1.xlsx — maps our internal control IDs to SIG questions and your RFP sections.
2) SOC 2 summary + select control narratives: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (non-sensitive excerpts).
3) Log extracts: access and privileged activity CSV for the requested audit window (we will redact user identifiers per our policy).
4) Architecture and dataflow diagram (PDF).
5) Private deployment / VPC checklist and KMS proof notes (for on-prem or VPC deployments we include an implementation guide).

A few clarifying asks so we can scope redactions and the NDA properly:
- Which RFP items require raw, unredacted logs vs. redacted samples?
- Do you need evidence of key rotation operations (procedural docs) or cryptographic proof (HSM vendor attestation)?

If procurement can sign an NDA, we can include a small set of unredacted artifacts under a controlled delivery (SFTP link) by 2027-07-30. Otherwise we'll provide redacted extracts and control narratives by that date and schedule a secure artifact handoff for anything more sensitive.

I’ve looped in Karthik and Mina for the technical artifacts and Jordan for the rollout/PM timeline. Proposed mutual action plan:
- 2027-07-27: Confirm NDA scope (procurement)
- 2027-07-29: Deliver crosswalk + SOC2 summary + redacted logs
- 2027-07-30: Provide secure link to restricted evidence if NDA in place
- 2027-08-03: Optional walkthrough call (30 mins)

Attachments: redwood-sig-ctrl-crosswalk-v1.xlsx; redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
team@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-07-27T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/SOC2 asks + evidence deadline for RFP (technical details)

Amir —

Quick technical note to supplement Tessa's plan:

What we'll include in the restricted evidence bundle (if NDA signed):
- KV access logs (sample) for the window 2027-06-01 -> 2027-07-20 (kv-access-logs-2027-07-20.csv). Logs will contain timestamps, request path, and operation type; we will hash internal user identifiers to preserve privacy.
- KMS/HSM attestation excerpt showing key rotation schedule and KMS provider (procedural doc + timestamps).
- Deployment checklist for VPC/private deployment (onprem-deploy-guide.pdf) with network zone diagrams and firewall rules.
- Canary/rollout runbook excerpt demonstrating automated fallbacks and A/B policy configurations.

Operational constraints and redaction approach:
- We cannot provide full, raw unmasked customer data. If Helios legal requires raw user identifiers, we will need an executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) + approved access request.
- For PCI/PHI-sensitive customers we have a separate escalation chain; confirm if Helios will request any of those scopes.

Timelines: we can produce the redacted CSV and crosswalk by 2027-07-29 (per Tessa). With an NDA and DPA in place we can put the restricted bundle on an SFTP site for pickup on 2027-07-30.

Attachments referenced: kv-access-logs-2027-07-20.csv; onprem-deploy-guide.pdf

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
